:::{#def-strict-subset}
#### Strict subset

A set $A$ is a **strict subset** of a set $B$,
written $A \subsetneq B$,
if $A$ is a [subset](#def-subset) of $B$
and $A \neq B$.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

Other sources call a strict subset a **proper subset**.
Sources disagree about the symbol $\subset$:
some use it for "subset" ($\subseteq$),
and others for "strict subset" ($\subsetneq$)
(see [Wikipedia: Subset](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Subset)).
These notes avoid $\subset$ and write $\subseteq$ or $\subsetneq$.

:::
